label: Diagram 3.1
caption: Diagram 3.1 Guarding design
description:
The image is a three‑column table headed "Diagram 3.1 Guarding design" in a green bar at the bottom. The column headers are "Building Category and location" (with the note "See paras 1.38, 3.2 and 3.4") and "Height (h)". The middle column lists locations, and the right column pairs each entry with a height figure and a small cross‑section symbol showing an L‑shaped guard with a vertical dimension arrow labelled "h".

The rows, in order, are: "Single family dwellings" with "Stairs, landings, ramps, edges of internal floors" at "900mm for all elements" and "External balconies, including Juliette balconies and edges of roof" at "1100mm"; "Factories and warehouses (light traffic)" with "Stairs, ramps" at "900mm" and "Landings and edges of floors" at "1100mm"; "Residential, institutional, educational, office and public buildings" with "All locations" at "900mm for flights otherwise 1100mm"; "Assembly" with "Within 530mm in front of fixed seating" at "800mm (h1)" and "All other locations" at "900mm for flights elsewhere 1100mm (h2)", its symbol showing a seated figure with two dimensions, h1 and h2; "Retail" with "All locations" at "900mm for flights otherwise 1100mm"; and "Glazing in all buildings" with "At opening windows except roof windows in loft extensions, see Approved Document B1" at "800mm" and "At glazing to changes of levels to provide containment" at "Below 800mm", its symbols showing window and level‑change sections with an arrow "h".
